data.name: About_Summary
data.value: SheetNest is a sheet nesting program: DXF import, automatic nesting of parts onto sheets, manual editing, common-line cutting, DXF export and a production PDF report.

data.name: Off_AutoTip
data.value: Weighs End, Side and Both against the layout the nest produced and keeps whichever frees the most material.

data.name: Off_BothTip
data.value: When the nest left room on both sides, the leftover comes away as two rectangles (guillotine cuts, so no cut ever splits a remnant in two).

data.name: Off_Enable
data.value: Cut the leftover off as a rectangular offcut

data.name: Off_EnableTip
data.value: Measures the free area the nest left on the last sheet and adds a cut line so it comes away as a reusable rectangle. It never moves a part: the nest is already finished by the time this is worked out, so turning it on cannot change where anything is placed.

data.name: Off_EndTip
data.value: A full strip at the end of the sheet's long side: the classic remnant.

data.name: Off_MaxXTip
data.value: Widest remnant still worth cutting off. Bigger than this and it is not a remnant but very nearly a sheet, so nothing is cut and the sheet is kept whole. 0 = no limit.

data.name: Off_MaxYTip
data.value: Tallest remnant still worth cutting off. 0 = no limit.

data.name: Off_MinXTip
data.value: Narrowest remnant worth separating. Below this the sheet is left uncut. 0 = automatic (5% of the sheet's side).

data.name: Off_MinYTip
data.value: Shortest remnant worth separating. 0 = automatic (5% of the sheet's side).

data.name: Off_OverlapTip
data.value: How far the cut runs PAST the sheet edge at each end, so the remnant comes away instead of hanging on by a bridge at the corners. 0 = flush with the edge.

data.name: Off_ResetTip
data.value: Puts the six numbers above back to the recommended figures for this drawing's units. The remnant position and the enable tick are left alone.

data.name: Off_SideTip
data.value: A full strip along the sheet's short side.

data.name: Off_SpacingTip
data.value: Gap kept between the packed parts and the offcut cut line (drawing units).

data.name: Part_CommonCuttingTip
data.value: Who this part may share a cut edge with. Full edges stay at the configured Common Line Gap and export as a cluster perimeter plus one midpoint common cut. Part spacing still applies everywhere else. Changing this choice explicitly enables common cutting for this part.

data.name: Part_ExtraTip
data.value: Spare parts nested on top of the required quantity (e.g. in case one is scrapped).

data.name: Part_FullSheetWarn
data.value: ⚠ This DXF looks like a FULL NESTED SHEET ({0} shapes inside a {1}×{2} frame), not a single part. SheetNest imports each DXF as ONE part, and the gaps between the inner shapes come from the original drawing. Export each part as its own DXF instead.

data.name: Part_LegacyCcHint
data.value: A saved legacy common-cutting mode is inactive. Choose a mode to confirm it for this part.

data.name: Part_MirroredTip
data.value: Copies nested MIRRORED (X-flipped) on top of the quantities above, for left-hand/right-hand pairs. The exported DXF cuts these mirrored.

data.name: Part_OrientationsTip
data.value: Rotations the nester may apply to THIS part (e.g. restrict for grain direction).

data.name: Part_PriorityTip
data.value: 1 = highest priority. Higher-priority parts are nested first, so they fill the earlier sheets and are never the ones left off when material runs out.

data.name: Part_SpacingTip
data.value: Gap this part keeps to the neighbours it may NOT share a cut with (drawing units). Two parts end up (spacingA + spacingB) / 2 apart.

data.name: Part_SymmetricHint
data.value: Detected rotation-symmetric shape (circle/square): turning it can't improve the nest, so "As drawn" saves the search.

data.name: Rep_NothingToReport
data.value: Nothing to report. Run a nest first.

data.name: Report_EmptySub
data.value: Run nesting on screen 3 to view and print the production report with specifications and cutting maps.

data.name: Rot_0And180Tip
data.value: 0° and 180°: respects material grain but can flip.

data.name: Rot_45Tip
data.value: Eight orientations, 45° apart. The job setting offers this too, and without it here a part could not be shown what it was really set to.

data.name: Rot_4WayTip
data.value: All four square orientations (0 / 90 / 180 / 270°). The safe first choice on square and L shaped parts: it usually beats free rotation on those, and always costs less to search.

data.name: Rot_90OnlyTip
data.value: Only 90°, so the part is always turned once.

data.name: Rot_AsDrawnTip
data.value: Only 0°, so the part stays exactly as drawn (respects grain).

data.name: Rot_FreeTip
data.value: Any angle, and NOT automatically the tightest. It wins on parts with slanted or curved edges, and loses on square or L shaped ones, which interlock exactly at right angles and gain nothing from being tilted. Measured on two real jobs: 84.3% of the block filled against 4-way's 81.6% on one, and 69.6% against 73.2% on the other. Costs about twice the search. Ignores grain.

data.name: Rot_JobTip
data.value: Whatever the job is set to, under Settings > Advanced Settings. Change it there and this part follows.

data.name: Set_AutosaveMinTip
data.value: How often the open project is automatically saved for recovery.

data.name: Set_AutosaveTip
data.value: Periodically snapshots the open project so unsaved work can be recovered after a crash.

data.name: Set_ClusterMaxTip
data.value: Hard maximum number of parts in one common-line cluster (2 to 500).

data.name: Set_ClusterModeTip
data.value: Auto lets SheetNest choose a safe cluster size; Manual applies a hard part-count limit.

data.name: Set_EffortTip
data.value: How long the nester searches each sheet. It buys a TIGHTER pack, not more parts on the sheet: the parts that fit are found almost at once, and the rest of the search is spent squeezing them together so the material left over comes back as one usable piece.

data.name: Set_GapTip
data.value: Common-line placements use the configured gap; SheetNest resolves one center cut before DXF export. The value is stored in inches and converted to the selected drawing units for display.

data.name: Set_MarginTip
data.value: Clear border kept between every part and the sheet edge.

data.name: Set_MergeTip
data.value: Legacy export option for ordinary geometry: combines coincident DXF entities. Common-line output resolves its single center cut independently before export.

data.name: Set_PartNamesTip
data.value: Export part file names as text inside each placed part for post-cut identification. PAINT is laser engraving/marking (the same layer as the bend lines); BACKGROUND is visible in CAD/CAM but never processed. Everything cut always goes on the CUT layer.

data.name: Set_RotationsTip
data.value: Rotations the nester may try for parts that have not been edited. Edit Part's per-part setting always wins.

data.name: Set_SpacingTip
data.value: Default gap between ordinary parts (drawing units). Edit Part can override it per part; common-line placements use the separate gap below.

data.name: Set_UnitsTip
data.value: Drawing units for parts, sheets, spacing and margins. Match the units your DXF files are drawn in; the physical common-line gap is converted automatically.

data.name: Settings_Concurrency_Tip
data.value: How many nesting searches run at the same time. Fewer keeps a slow computer responsive; more finishes sooner on a fast one. The nest itself comes out the same either way.

data.name: Settings_PartNames_Layer9
data.value: PAINT — engraved, with the bend lines

data.name: Sheet_Dlg_Header
data.value: Sheet size in {0} (width = the long side).

data.name: Sheet_PriorityTip
data.value: Sheet consumption priority: sheets with highest priority are consumed first (e.g. offcuts and remnants).

data.name: Sheet_RememberTip
data.value: Save this size under "My sheets" in the Add Sheet menu.

data.name: Sheet_UnlimitedTip
data.value: There is as much of this size as the job needs, so the nest keeps taking sheets until every part is placed. Quantity is ignored while this is ticked (it keeps its value for when you untick it).

data.name: Tip_FlipUpDown

data.name: Tip_Multiplier

data.name: Tip_PartColor

data.name: Tip_PartDetails

data.name: Tip_PartMirrorQty

data.name: Fill_MinShareTip
data.value: Parts smaller than this share of the offcut are not tried: they would take long to place and add little.

data.name: Fill_Empty

data.name: Msg_FillNothing

data.name: Library_SaveTip

data.name: Library_PatternNote
data.value: Saved as a pattern without its length and width: on an offcut it is drawn to the offcut's size.

data.name: Library_DrawingNote
data.value: Saved as a drawing of the size typed.

data.name: Set_LibraryTip
data.value: The folder the parts library is read from; each subfolder is a group. A shared folder makes one library for every PC.

data.name: Tip_PartFill
data.value: No count: the nest puts on as many as the sheets have room for once every counted part is on.

data.name: Shape_FitSheetNote
data.value: Length and width are the sheet, {0} × {1} {2}: the tape is drawn inside its margins, the sheet goes into the job and nesting starts at once.
